Our Rewards Program

Earn Rewards

Earn rewards with the Care Plasma Paysign Debit Card

At Care Plasma, we deeply value our donors and strive to show our appreciation for their commitment to saving lives through plasma donation.

To enhance your experience, we offer the Care Plasma Paysign Debit Card — which works essentially just like any other debit card. Feel free to use it as you would your normal debit card.

What Is It?

What is the Care Plasma Paysign Debit Card?

The Care Plasma Paysign Debit Card is a special reward card provided to our donors on their initial visit. It's a Visa debit card, accepted anywhere Visa is accepted — a symbol of our appreciation and a gateway to exclusive benefits.

How Does It Work?

From your first visit to every reward after

01

Issuance of the card

When you visit us for your first donation, you'll receive your Care Plasma Paysign Debit Card, loaded with perks designed to make donating even more rewarding.

02

Reward accumulation

Every time you donate plasma, your card is credited with cashback — rewarding you for your ongoing commitment to our cause.

03

Cashback and rewards

Earn up to 40% cashback shopping at thousands of participating online stores, local restaurants, and hotels worldwide.

04

Convenience of use

The Paysign card is widely accepted, making it easy to access your earned rewards wherever you prefer.

Card Benefits

Benefits of the Care Plasma Paysign Debit Card

Exclusive offers

Enjoy exclusive deals and discounts at participating stores, restaurants, and hotels.

Cash back

Earn up to 40% cashback shopping at thousands of participating online stores, local restaurants, and hotels worldwide.

Pharmacy discounts

Access a comprehensive pharmacy discount program with instant savings of up to 80% on prescriptions.

Global accessibility

The Paysign card is widely accepted, so you can access your rewards conveniently, wherever you are.

Flexible redemption

Redeem your earned cashback or points on your own schedule, however and whenever you like.
